name: sc2-coach
description: StarCraft II AI Coach from StarCraft2.ai: ask SC2 questions, upload your replays, get a coaching report and ask follow-up questions about your games.

interface.shortDescription: Coach your StarCraft II games with StarCraft2.ai
interface.longDescription: Ask StarCraft II questions answered from Liquipedia, patch notes and pro-game insights; upload a replay from your computer; get an AI Coach report and ask follow-up questions about the game. Uses your StarCraft2.ai account and minerals at the website's prices, and never spends without your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my latest StarCraft II replay
What counters mass Void Rays in ZvP?
What should I practice from my last game?
